in_arabic.name: Farrahah
in_arabic.long_meaning: Farrahah هو اسم عربي إسلامي يحمل معنى عميقاً في الثقافة الإسلامية. Derived from the Arabic root 'farrah', meaning 'to exalt, to be proud, or to be noble'. In Islamic context, Farrahah symbolizes the virtues of being proud of one's faith and upholding noble character.
